chunks.text: Welcome to the Slow English podcast.
In this podcast, we speak slow and easy English.
Today, we talk about a beautiful and historical city.
The city is Prizren.
Prizren is in Kosovo.
Kosovo is a country in southeast Europe.
Prizren is one of the oldest and most beautiful cities in the country.
Part 2.
Prizren is located near mountains.
The city has a river called the Lombardi River.
The river goes through the city center.
This makes the city very peaceful and beautiful.
Part 3.
Prizren has a long history.
Many different cultures lived here in the past.
Because of this, the city has a mix of traditions.
You can see different influences in architecture and culture.
Part 4.
One famous place in Prizren is the Old Stone Bridge.
This bridge is in the city center.
People walk across it every day.
It is a symbol of the city.
Part 5.
Another important place is Prizren Fortress.
It is on a hill above the city.
From the fortress, you can see all of Prizren.
The view is very beautiful, especially at sunset.
Part 6.
The old town of Prizren is very charming.
There are narrow streets and old houses.
People walk, shop, and drink coffee in small cafes.
The atmosphere is calm and friendly.
Part 7.
Prizren has many mosques and churches.
This shows the cultural diversity of the city.
Different communities live together in peace.
This is an important part of Prizren's identity.
Part 8.
Food in Prizren is delicious and traditional.
People eat grilled meat, bread, and vegetables.
One popular food is called Burek.
It is a pastry filled with meat or cheese.
Part 9.
The people of Prizren are friendly and welcoming.
Visitors often feel safe and comfortable.
Hospitality is very important in daily life.
People like to share food and tea with guests.
Part 10.
The weather in Prizren is warm in summer.
Winters can be cold and snowy.
Spring is green and beautiful.
Many visitors come in spring and summer.
Part 11.
Prizren also has festivals.
One famous event is Dokufest.
It is a film festival.
People from many countries come to watch films and enjoy the city.
Part 12.
Prizren is a beautiful city full of history, culture, and nature.
The river, fortress, and old streets make it special.
Visitors can enjoy peace, tradition, and friendly people.
Even though it is not very big, Prizren is a wonderful place to discover.
Thank you for listening to the Slow English Podcast.
My name is Amili.
See you in the next episode.
